mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( name, login_id, phone, password_hash, is_marketing_agreed ) VALUES ( #{request.name}, #{request.loginId}, #{request.phone}, #{encodedPassword}, #{request.marketingAgreed} )
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, password_hash FROM users WHERE login_id = #{loginId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_token (user_id, token_hash) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE token_hash = #{tokenHash}
mapper.select: SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.address, c.category_name FROM payment_transaction pt JOIN user_card uc ON uc.user_card_id = pt.user_card_id JOIN store s ON s.store_id = pt.store_id JOIN category c ON c.category_id = s.category_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.is_deleted = 0 AND pt.paid_at >= (NOW() - INTERVAL 1 MONTH) GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, s.address, c.category_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MAX(pt.paid_at) DESC LIMIT 3
